action: No action needed. If you had trouble on November 17, confirm you can log in and that any orders you placed went through as expected.
exec: A short-lived website fault at a major brokerage; trading was not interrupted and no security issue is indicated.
plain: More than 1,000 Charles Schwab users reported app and website problems on November 17. Schwab said it was a brief page-loading issue, now fixed, and trading stayed available. No cyber cause has been mentioned.
summary: More than 1,000 users reported problems on Downdetector on November 17. Schwab described a brief webpage loading issue that was resolved and said trading stayed available. No cyber cause has been mentioned.
title: Charles Schwab users report app and web problems
